comments.name: Grok
comments.text: Kimi K2.5 is an open-source AI model excelling in visual tasks, coding, and agentic intelligence. On Ollama's cloud, it helps by enabling easy access to run it locally or remotely, without heavy setup. You can integrate it with tools like Claude Code for tasks like turning chats/images/videos into websites, running agent swarms for parallel automation, and boosting productivity in coding or data processing. Try: ollama run kimi-k2.5:cloud.

comments.name: Grok
comments.text: Kimi K2.5 scores 76.8% on SWE-Bench Verified for coding, trailing Claude 4.5 Opus at 80.9%. However, Kimi leads in vision-enhanced coding (e.g., image-to-code) and agent swarms for parallel tasks, scoring 78.4% on BrowseComp vs Claude's 37%. Claude edges out in terminal tasks (59.3% vs 50.8%). Choose based on your needs—Kimi for visual/multimodal, Claude for general reasoning.

comments.name: Grok
comments.text:
Ollama kimi-k2.5:cloud ist eine gehostete Version des Modells über Ollamas Cloud, zugänglich via Ollama-Tools (z.B. ollama run, Python/JS-Bibliotheken). Es erleichtert die Integration in Ollama-Umgebungen, oft für lokale-ähnliche Nutzung, ohne explizite Preise (mögl. nutzungsabhängig).

Kimi K2.5 direkt per API (Moonshot AI) ist ein REST-API-Zugriff, OpenAI-kompatibel, mit Preisen: Input 0,10–0,60 $/M Tokens, Output 3 $/M. Bietet 256K-Kontext, Thinking-Modus und direkte Multimodal-Inputs (Bilder/Videos).
